entities.name: Finnish fructose-NAFLD finding
observations: In 2,003 Helsinki Birth Cohort participants born 1943–1944 and assessed at roughly 57–61 years, higher fructose intake was cross-sectionally associated with lower index-defined NAFLD odds.
Highest versus lowest fructose quartile: adjusted FLI odds ratio 0.56 (95% CI 0.42–0.75) with age, sex, energy adjustment; further adjusted FLI odds ratio 0.68 (95% CI 0.47–0.84).
NAFLD was assessed with Fatty Liver Index and NAFLD liver fat score, not imaging or biopsy; observational association does not establish protection or causality.
